# Original region fixture

Region (-1, 0), four planes. The ground plane is grass with a blocked floor, reciprocal cardinal and diagonal walls, a blocked corner, two material overlays and a small slope. Plane 1 has a 2 x 2 surface; planes 2 and 3 have no surface. The expected observations are independent test inputs. The binary file and SHA-256 will be generated and verified by the compiler implementation; they are not present in this proposal. All data is original, test-only, with project license approval pending #20.
